evidence.reason: render_units recursively enumerates all crq-* templates under apps/crq-python/ops/systemd and identifies them by Path(source).name, then writes each rendered unit to output / source.name without checking for duplicate basenames. If two templates in different subdirectories share a basename, the later atomic_bytes call silently overwrites the earlier output and paths contains duplicate targets; no error is raised. Unique basenames continue to render normally, so rejecting duplicate basenames before the write loop is a routine correctness fix rather than a new requirement.
